Subject: MAP + close timeline: procurement delay -- need to rebaseline

Hi Jasmine,

Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed the legal review and insurance sign-off out by two full weeks due to a backlog with our vendor risk team. That puts our previously agreed 10/22 close at risk.

We completed the last evaluation run this morning; attaching the evaluation_summary for your reference. The team is still excited about the UX and throughput, but procurement will be the gating factor.

Can we discuss a short-term plan that lets us keep momentum (evaluation checkpoints + staged commitment) without committing to the full production cutover until procurement finishes?

Suggested asks:
- A one-week extension on the pilot access (if possible)
- An updated MAP that splits the go-live into two phases: pilot-to-staging, then staging-to-prod
- A clear set of success criteria that procurement can use to approve faster

Appreciate any help. I can do a call Monday morning PST.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Carter
Director, Clinical Ops
NimbusHealth

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads-up and the evaluation summary. Sorry to hear procurement is backed up. We can absolutely avoid losing momentum.

High-level proposal (attached MAP_v2_Nimbus.pdf):
- Phase A (pilot -> staging): extend pilot window by 2 weeks, staging environment validation, KPI check-in at +7 days
- Phase B (staging -> prod): conditional on procurement sign-off + completed SOC2 evidence review; targeted within 2 weeks after sign-off
- Acceptance criteria for Phase A: 95th pct latency under 350ms for 95% of sampled sessions OR error rate < 0.5% over a 48-hour window; procurement will get a concise one-page evidence packet for their review

Next steps I propose:
1) We approve a 2-week pilot extension (no additional cost for that window).
2) Marissa will schedule the Phase A KPI check-in and own the acceptance artifacts.
3) Karthik and I will update the technical risk log and add mitigation owners.
4) If procurement needs an exec-level note or credit, we escalate to our CS leadership.

I copied Marissa so she can own scheduling and capture the MAP changes. I’ll also loop in Karthik for the technical mitigations.

Attached: MAP_v2_Nimbus.pdf (doc, 120 KB)

Adding a technical risk log entry and suggested mitigations — see inline. I can stand up the staging validation run early next week.

Risk log (new entry):
- ID: R-2026-10-NBH-01
- Title: Delayed procurement forces extended pilot, increasing exposure to configuration drift and data mismatch between pilot/staging
- Likelihood: Medium
- Impact: Medium-high (may require rework of deployment scripts + retest of inference config)
- Mitigation owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
- Mitigation steps:
  1) Lock pilot config using immutable snapshot (we will export KV cache, model pin, and tokenizer hashes).
  2) Run a short smoke validation on staging mirroring the last 48 hours of pilot traffic (sampling 5k requests).
  3) If drift is detected, we will apply a targeted release patch (no full rollback) and run acceptance tests before Phase B.
- Target by: 2026-10-15

Operational asks for Marissa: please capture the acceptance artifacts (logs, latency distribution, sample transcripts) and upload to the shared MAP folder. I’ll coordinate the staging run on Monday (ETA: 10/12).

Attachment: risk_log_nimbus.tsv (text, 4 KB)
